1.explanation:
• BpmnCopyPaste.js hooks into the diagram‐js copy/paste API and orchestrates serializing both BPMN and BPMNDI elements. It currently only grabs shapes and edges but doesn’t pull in nested label DI (BPMNLabel) elements.

• ModdleCopy.js is responsible for walking the moddle tree and cloning out the sub-trees to copy. Because the copy logic filters out BPMNLabel and their DC bounds, the serialized snippet passed to the importer has no label metadata.

• BpmnImporter.js rehydrates the copied XML into shapes and DI. With no <bpmndi:BPMNLabel> present in the paste payload, it never creates the label shapes, so even though the semantic name is on the element, there’s no DI to render it.

Fixing this requires updating ModdleCopy (and the copy filters in BpmnCopyPaste) to include BPMNLabel DI sub-elements and ensuring the importer sees them on paste so that labels get drawn again.
1.bug_scenario: When copying all the child shapes of a Participant (pool) and then pasting them into the root process, the event and activity labels (e.g. the “A” on the StartEvent and the “B” on the EndEvent) are dropped. You can see in the gif that the circles and rectangle all re-appear after paste, but their name labels are gone. This stems from the custom BPMN copy/paste implementation not including the BPMNLabel DI elements (nor re-attaching them on paste), so when the importer runs there’s no label shape to render.

2.explanation: Both BpmnCopyPaste.js and ModdleCopy.js drive the BPMN copy/paste operation – they decide which elements (semantic + DI) to copy and how to re‐attach them on paste. Right now they only handle the main shapes and their flows; they don’t pick up or re‐wire the attached label shapes. ModdleCopy.js needs to deep copy the <bpmndi:BPMNLabel> DI elements, and BpmnCopyPaste.js must merge them back onto their host during paste. LabelUtil.js contains helper routines for dealing with labels (finding anchors, calculating offsets) and will need to be used to properly hook the copied label DI back to the pasted shape so that the text reappears.
2.bug_scenario: When you copy all of the participant’s child shapes (start‐event, task, end‐event) out of a pool and then paste them into the process, the graphical shapes show up correctly but their labels (“A” and “B”) are missing – they never get re‐attached during the paste. In the GIF you can see the two circles and the task rectangle paste over, but the text labels underneath them have been dropped.
